title: [UE-0.8] Graybox arena
body:
### MVP item (number from docs/jam-brief.md), Day 0, or Stretch: <name>

Day 0

### GDD ref (section + short quote; "none" for tooling cards)

none

### GDD revision (the one in docs/gdd/CURRENT, e.g. 1.3)

1.3

### Features (IDs from docs/feature-manifest.json; add "Hook only" for an interface + default flag with no behavior, OPEN/PROPOSED only; "none" for tooling cards)

none

### Player outcome (the player sees X, does Y, can tell why; "none" for tooling cards)

none

### Owner role

Integrator

### Reviewer role (must differ from owner)

Dev Lead

### Human who runs and merges this

Josh

### Inputs and outputs (exact paths)

Inputs: the files the Done-when names. Outputs: `Content/UmbrellaElla/Maps/L_Graybox.umap`, its `+MapsToCook` line in `Config/DefaultGame.ini`, `Content/UmbrellaElla/Blueprints/BP_Ella.uasset`, `Content/UmbrellaElla/Blueprints/BP_GameMode.uasset`

### Context (what the code or asset next to Outputs does today, with file:line)

new files only

### File lane, do-not-touch paths, binary files to lock

Lane: `Content/UmbrellaElla/Maps/L_Graybox.umap`, its `+MapsToCook` line in `Config/DefaultGame.ini`, `Content/UmbrellaElla/Blueprints/BP_Ella.uasset`, `Content/UmbrellaElla/Blueprints/BP_GameMode.uasset`
Do not touch: other maps under Content/UmbrellaElla/Maps/
Locks: Content/UmbrellaElla/Maps/L_Graybox.umap, Content/UmbrellaElla/Blueprints/BP_Ella.uasset, Content/UmbrellaElla/Blueprints/BP_GameMode.uasset

### Out of scope (behaviors not to build; the reviewer rejects them)

anything outside the lane

### After (cards that must merge first: #<n> or UE-<n>, comma separated; "none")

UE-0.3

### Used by (BPs, maps, widgets or components that read what this card changes; follow-up card IDs)

UE-0.4b, UE-0.6, UE-0.8a, UE-0.10a

### Needs (build | tests | editor MCP | Windows packaging machine)

build, tests, Windows packaging machine

### Done when (each line checkable)

- [ ] L_Graybox is one screen with a fixed camera: top and side bounds, a bottom exit volume, a hero start and an owl placeholder at the GDD 1.3 §7B fixture: 1600 x 900 cm arena, player at x=-350 z=0, owl at x=+560 (`docs/feature-manifest.json` approved_parameters.fixtures, the numbers `pipeline/level/encounter.json` uses)
- [ ] `+MapsToCook=(FilePath="/Game/UmbrellaElla/Maps/L_Graybox")` is in `Config/DefaultGame.ini`
- [ ] `BP_Ella` (parent `AEllaCharacter`) sets the `IA_*` and `IMC_*` references, and `BP_GameMode` sets DefaultPawnClass to `BP_Ella`. L_Graybox's World Settings GameMode Override is `BP_GameMode` (property values pasted)
- [ ] A Development package opens it: `grep -c L_Graybox` on the packaged run's log prints 1 or more (pasted). If card 0.6 has not merged yet, the PR uses the same `SMOKE_BOOTSTRAP` line as card 0.3; once it has, it pastes SMOKE_OK (input=none with `SMOKE_REQUIRE_INPUT=0` only until MVP 2's QA-01 row is merged)

### Budget and cut tier

60 min agent + 15 min human, MVP

### Unknowns (Decision needed / Why it matters / Proposed test / Choice; "none" if none)

none
